kitDescription: Laplace (Treasure) is an Iron rocket-launcher Attacker whose every full-charge shot builds Hero Vision (an explosion-radius self-buff that stacks to 5) and lands a 132.45% of final ATK bonus hit on the target, with an additional small hit when striking destructible parts. Her burst swaps her launcher for a 10-second piercing beam: one large 1455.72% opening hit, then a stream of 22.2% normal-damage ticks, gaining Pierce for the duration. While Hero Vision is at max stacks during the burst, the beam's normal damage is dealt as true damage, and each beam hit on the same enemy adds an 11.9% of final ATK true-damage bonus hit. She cannot take cover while the burst weapon is active. Gameplay-wise she simply keeps firing full charges so Hero Vision is capped before every burst window.

gotchas.summary: S2a 132.45% full-charge rider fires on the swap-beam ticks (no swapGate); both blind derivations and the burst text's 'Normal Damage' wording read exclusion; probe: -38.1% of her total if flipped
gotchas.evidence: Kit: S2 'hitting a target with Full Charge' vs burst 'Normal Damage: 22.2%' labeling the beam; SSOT 2b (swapGate is the sanctioned per-shot scope primitive, snow-white precedent); driver override skill2 block (shotFired, no swapGate) vs S6 blind (shotFired + swapGate:unswapped) and S2b reviewer (same); driver probe 466.8M -> 289.1M. Driver's inclusion rationale cites chargeTimeSec 0.25, its own kit-silent ⚑ — circular.
gotchas.suggestedFix: needs measurement + recipe: in any laplace focus video, count 132.45%-class popups during the 10s swap window vs outside it; if absent in-window (the reading both blinds and the 'Normal Damage' wording favor), add swapGate:'unswapped' to the skill2 block. The faithful interim encoding per blind consensus is the swapGate; the current every-shot reading may not ship silently.

verdictRationale: One real high-severity gotcha blocks GO: the S2a 132.45% rider's trigger scope. The driver fires it on every shot including the 10s swap beam, a reading justified only by its own calibrated chargeTimeSec ⚑, contradicted by BOTH independent blind derivations (S2b reviewer and S6) and by the burst text's own 'Normal Damage' label for the beam — with a measured -38.1% total swing if flipped. The fix is cheap and faithful-by-consensus (swapGate:'unswapped') or a defined popup-count measurement; it must not ship on the aggressive reading by default. Everything else converged strongly: the treasure magnitudes (132.45 / 1455.72 / 22.2 / 10s / 11.9) all discriminate RED against the untreasured base kit; First Damage's pre-FB timing matches the measured boundary rule; Pierce was a genuine blind catch the driver acted on (swap-scoped, converged by S6); the Hero Vision stack gate and swap-beam economy are documented, provably-inert-or-flagged ⚑s, not drops. Of the 6 S5 reds, 4 are the inexpressible stack channel (documented gap), 1 is a blind harness bug (onEvent at the wrong level), and 1 is a gauge-coupled counterfactual artifact — none a driver defect. Same-model residual for the owner to spot-check: every agent here shares one model family, so the unanimous 'beam economy is kit-silent' could be a shared blind spot — the 0.25s-tick/999-ammo swap calibration (the largest single lever on her board number) and the S2a scope interact multiplicatively, and both need the same focus-video popup count to resolve. For GO: resolve the S2a scope (measurement or the swapGate) and re-run the two test suites.
